localization.helpful_memory_target_selection: all single-source cases selected 1/1 annotated helpful item and both multi-source cases selected 3/3; unstable response uptake therefore cannot be attributed mainly to missing the annotated target
localization.memory_harmful_direction: 2/2 pairs had the expected negative BGE delta
localization.strategy_harmful_direction: 0/2 pairs had the expected negative BGE delta; reducing the surface to a single strategy can concentrate rather than remove exposure to that strategy
localization.overall: a uniform top-1 post-retrieval evidence-surface restriction did not establish the preregistered bidirectional mechanism signal

forbidden_followups: change the frozen uptake threshold or primary metric using these outcomes
create longitudinal action labels from this report
authorize learned PM training from the unsupported longitudinal supervision
claim that top-1 evidence filtering improves response quality
open longitudinal internal-test to rescue the result
allowed_interpretation: report-only root-cause evidence and a disclosed limitation; future work may separately redesign item selection, strategy-card construction, generator evidence-use training, and measurement using new preregistered data
